data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘Sawan’ meaning sun and ‘Ayin’ meaning flower. It symbolizes the beauty and brightness of the sun and the delicate nature of a flower. This name is perfect for a baby girl born during the sunny season or for someone who is radiant and beautiful.
